collected_by: firmware-atlas (picked up after box-field/pc-fw went offline mid-run)
method: direct HTTP, honest user agent 'firmware-atlas-research/1.0', 2s between requests
robots: verified before collecting: naijarom.com/robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/, /readme.html and /refer/. No AI crawler is named. Device pages are permitted.

not_collected.romprovider.com: robots.txt Disallow: / for User-agent ClaudeBot. Skipped deliberately; putting a browser UA in front of that would be circumvention, not collection.

field_notes.filename: VERBATIM as published. The parsed columns beside it are best-effort and must never be treated as the source of truth.
field_notes.date_token: a 6-digit token from the filename, NOT a patch level and NOT reliably a release date. Do not join it as a security level.
field_notes.chipset: MediaTek part number where the filename carries one (483 of 1338 rows).
field_notes.market: vendor market code (OP001PF001AZ etc), not an ISO region.
field_notes.file_size: often empty; the size regex did not match most pages. Known gap.

measured_value_against_frbox.honest_summary: FRBox already covers every model here. The genuine addition is 237 build records (18% of rows). This is a supplement, not a primary source.
